audit_items.proof_trace: All server action paths that handle other users' discord_uid strip it before returning: getAllUsersWithStatus() fetches discord_uid internally but the UserWithDetails return type excludes it (user.service.ts:6-19), recordAttendance() explicitly destructures discord_uid away at line 99, and the admin user detail page checks is_admin before accessing any other user's row. Dashboard queries are always scoped to the caller's own user_id. Even if a non-admin bypasses the page-level layout guard and directly POSTs to a server action, no discord_uid is present in any response payload.
